title: Dispatch: beor long option list paging/search (Haiku 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Plan for parent eshyra-beor (bd show eshyra-beor). WORKTREE: .worktrees/eshyra-beor.1 (branch eshyra-beor.1 from origin/main). Deps installed. Edit ONLY packages/cli/src/playProgression.ts and its CLI test (find with grep -rl playProgression packages/cli/test). Never use git stash.

CODE: playProgression.ts describeChoice() (~line 243) prints every option of a level-up choice (Magical Secrets lists ~300 spells); the answer loop above it (~line 210-240) reads one line per choice.
DECISIONS: when a choice has more than 40 options, describeChoice prints only the count plus the first 40 and the hint "(type 'search <text>' to filter, 'more' for the next page)". The answer loop treats 'search <text>' (case-insensitive substring over id and name) and 'more' as navigation commands that re-print a filtered/next page and re-prompt the SAME choice without recording an answer; any other input is an answer as today. Short lists (<=40) behave exactly as today. Replace/prepare hints keep working.
EVIDENCE: a test with a long option list (a bard 9->10 Magical Secrets level-up via the existing CLI test harness, or a synthetic choice if the harness supports it cheaply): first page shows 40 + hint; 'search fire' shows only matches (e.g. fireball); 'more' shows the next page; then a valid id is accepted and the level-up proceeds. Existing playProgression tests unchanged.
PROTOCOL: npm run verify:worktree BEFORE commit; commit (Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>); bd update eshyra-beor.1 --append-notes; bd close eshyra-beor.1. No push/PR.
notes: Implemented in d00c5676 (branch eshyra-beor.1). playProgression.ts: choices with >40 options print count, first 40 (paged), and hint (type 'search ' to filter, 'more' for next page); 'search <text>' (case-insensitive over id/name) and 'more' re-prompt the same choice without recording an answer; lists <=40 unchanged. collectSupportedChoices is now exported for tests. Tests: 3 new cases in packages/cli/test/play.test.ts (describe 'paged level-up option lists') using a synthetic 300-option choice: first page + hint, search fire, more page, valid id accepted, short list unchanged. Wizard spellbook list is only 27 options so the live /levelup flow test cannot exercise paging; the bard Magical Secrets fixture was judged too heavy. npm run verify:worktree passed (exit 0; 6329 passed, 3 skipped).
